title: Chart style
description: radar = polar chart of aim, speed, accuracy and flashlight pp on one shared scale (flashlight appears as a fourth axis only with FL). bars = the same split as a bar under each row, a little shorter. Results always use the small radar.

title: Show FC layer
description: Draws the full-combo projection (dashed outline / grey bar) behind the live split and shows the If FC pp column. The scale follows the FC values either way, so the live layer grows towards the edge as the play progresses.

title: Show map profile in gameplay
description: Strip under the chart: aim strain above the centre line, speed strain below, across the whole map, with the playback position and the map's overall aim/speed share.

title: Gameplay zone
description: Side band beside the 4:3 playfield, clear of hit objects that overhang its edge. right = between the playfield and the key counter, under score/accuracy. left = mirrored; it meets stable's in-game leaderboard, so use it when that is hidden.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the overlay horizontally (1080p pixels) from its default spot in every screen, for skins that place the HUD elsewhere.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the overlay vertically (1080p pixels) from its default spot in every screen.

title: Scale / %
description: Size of the overlay; clamped to 50–200 %.

title: Backing
description: none = marks float on the game (text shadow, a feathered dark face behind the radar and strip). scrim = adds a soft dark fade behind the whole cluster for bright backgrounds. panel = a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the live layer and playhead. map = a tone from the current map's background (falls back to 18-LAB amber when the background is grey or missing). 18-lab = always amber.

title: Show in song select
description: Song select shows the selected map's aim/speed strain profile and its SS and 99% pp, which osu!stable does not show, in the free centre column between the leaderboard and the carousel.

title: Show on results
description: The results screen shows the final pp split by skill against the FC projection (not shown by osu!stable) in the right end of the header strip.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Small brand tag beside the overlay label.
